description: This file defines the ProductPriceDescription entity class, which extends Description and is mapped to the PRODUCT_PRICE_DESCRIPTION database table. It establishes a relationship to the ProductPrice class and manages price description data for products with localization support.

classes.name: ProductPriceDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing localized descriptions for a product's price, including relationships to ProductPrice.
